subject: Emotions
title: The Surprise Face
description: A short lesson to help you apply The Surprise Face.

hook.text: Raised eyebrows, wide eyes, dropped jaw. The surprise face is identical in Tokyo, New York, and the Amazon.

buildup.text: Darwin proposed that expressions are evolved, not learned. Blind athletes make the same surprise face.

discovery.text: The wide eyes serve a purpose: they widen the visual field to take in more info during uncertainty.

twist.text: Fake surprise is easy to spot. Real surprise lasts under a second; performed surprise lingers too long.

climax.text: AI facial recognition struggles with surprise because it's brief and morphs quickly into another emotion.

punchline.text: The face of surprise is a door that opens and shuts in a blink.

quiz.question: Why do our eyes widen during surprise?
